sources.label: TSETMC instrument search and daily history

sources.label: CODAL company disclosures

sources.history_limit: Search response only; publication and amendment history require validation

sources.label: World Bank Indicators API
sources.authentication: none required by current official API documentation
sources.probe_mode: Iran annual CPI inflation indicator, bounded to selected years
sources.history_limit: Indicator-specific; API supports long annual histories but data may be missing or revised
limitations: Annual observation year is not publication time
Not a substitute for daily prices
Indicator definitions and licensing/redistribution conditions still need review

sources.label: Binance Spot public klines
sources.probe_mode: up to five daily BTCUSDT candles
sources.history_limit: Public kline endpoint supports pagination; completeness must be audited over the requested window
limitations: BTCUSDT is venue/pair-specific and is not the same as USD spot
Network/geographic access may vary
Usage terms, storage, derived outputs and commercial display rights require review

sources.label: Tindex free-tier public API
sources.authentication: TINDEX_API_BASE_URL and TINDEX_API_TOKEN in environment only
sources.history_limit: Documented indicator history/candles window up to about 100 days
limitations: Account-level endpoint access is not established by public docs
Commercial/high-volume use requires provider terms
Never infer units or free-vs-official market semantics

sources.label: Tindex indicator candle history
sources.authentication: TINDEX_API_BASE_URL and TINDEX_API_TOKEN in environment only
sources.probe_mode: up to three explicit slugs per run (local client limit is three requests per minute)
sources.history_limit: At most about 100 days on the documented endpoint
limitations: Slugs must be verified against the user's account
Do not combine with snapshots until symbols, venue, units and overlap reconcile
All outputs are candidates only

sources.label: FRED/ALFRED observations and vintages
limitations: Observation period is not release time
